nl_spec: Design an operational amplifier (differential input, single-ended output) in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: load capacitance 2 pF; a 10 uA reference current is available at ibias. Requirements: DC gain of at least 79 dB; unity-gain bandwidth of at least 34 MHz; phase margin of at least 63 degrees; 1% settling time for the large step of at most 250 ns; input-referred noise density at 1 kHz of at most 330 nV/sqrt(Hz); CMRR at low frequency of at least 86 dB; slew rate of at least 5 MV/s; output swing of at least 1.56 V; total power consumption (including the reference current) of at most 68 uW; PSRR (VDD) at low frequency of at least 76 dB.

Design an operational amplifier (differential input, single-ended output) in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: load capacitance 2 pF; a 10 uA reference current is available at ibias. Requirements: DC gain of at least 46 dB; unity-gain bandwidth of at least 6.4 MHz; phase margin of at least 70 degrees; PSRR (VDD) at low frequency of at least 44 dB; total power consumption (including the reference current) of at most 38 uW; output swing of at least 1.55 V; CMRR at low frequency of at least 54 dB; input-referred noise density at 1 kHz of at most 170 nV/sqrt(Hz).

Design an operational amplifier (differential input, single-ended output) in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: load capacitance 2 pF; a 10 uA reference current is available at ibias. Requirements: DC gain of at least 71 dB; unity-gain bandwidth of at least 20 MHz; phase margin of at least 61 degrees; output swing of at least 1.18 V; slew rate of at least 15 MV/s; PSRR (VDD) at low frequency of at least 34 dB; CMRR at low frequency of at least 34 dB; total power consumption (including the reference current) of at most 530 uW; input-referred noise density at 1 kHz of at most 280 nV/sqrt(Hz). All requirements must hold across process corners (tt, ff, ss, sf, fs), temperatures -40/27/125 C and supply 1.62-1.98 V.

Design a single-ended voltage amplifier in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: load capacitance 500 fF; input DC bias 0.75 V. Requirements: DC gain of at least 33 dB; -3 dB bandwidth of at least 5 MHz; gain-bandwidth product of at least 270 MHz; total power consumption (including the reference current) of at most 200 uW; output swing of at least 1.07 V; output DC level between 0.45 V and 1.35 V.
